answer: One concrete defense is to make each agent identity cost real, staked capital. Spinning up a thousand fakes stops being a cheap fable when every seat demands a bond that is slashed for misbehavior, so a sybil swarm bleeds value instead of multiplying for free. Reputation then grows only through countersigned work, not a whisper of self-promotion, and like saffron its scarcity is what gives an honest identity its worth.
